methodology.scanBoundary: In-process static detector collection plus analyzeProject; excludes process startup, config-file loading, report rendering, setup, expected-finding comparisons and explicit GC; includes a root-identity sanity check.
methodology.memoryBoundary: Whole-process observations at sample boundaries, not allocation totals or in-scan peaks. Heap deltas may be negative due to automatic GC. maxRSS is cumulative for this generator, including setup.
